threat_event: Ransomware on the laptop encrypts synced files and steals carrier packets; saved browser sessions expose the TMS and bank
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Carrier packets synced to the laptop; no copy independent of the vendors; home network shared with household devices; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-07 laptop; SYS-02 files; BP-01 to BP-04
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; built-in antivirus; automatic updates
treatment_plan: Monthly offline export of carrier and contract folders; stop syncing carrier packets to the laptop; separate network for business devices; annual security course; P08 runbook

threat_event: Fraudster posing as a carrier gets the carrier's bank details changed, and the next ACH payment goes to the fraudster; the real carrier then claims against the surety bond
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes accepted by email with no call-back; payee-change alerts off; TMS change log never reviewed; near miss on 2026-05-19
existing_controls: Weekly ACH batch gives time to notice; bank hardware token
treatment_plan: Call-back to the phone number in the carrier file (never the number in the request) before any bank detail change; 5-business-day hold on payments after a change; bank payee-change alerts on; check the TMS change log before each ACH batch

threat_event: Takeover of the business email account, used to send shippers fake invoices with new bank details and to read carrier packets
threat_source: Cybercriminal (phishing, phone number port-out, password reuse)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Text-message MFA only; no port-out PIN on the mobile carrier account; no sign-in review
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 email and files; SYS-08 phone number
treatment_plan: Authenticator app plus a hardware security key; port-out and account PIN with the mobile carrier; password manager; monthly sign-in review

threat_event: Fraudster impersonates a legitimate carrier (or a booked carrier re-brokers the load) and the freight is stolen or delivered late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vetting checks authority and insurance but not identity; one double-brokered load in 2025; contingent cargo cover is $100,000 per load
existing_controls: Carrier monitoring service alerts; load tracking
treatment_plan: Identity check before the first load (email domain and phone match the registered contact; call the registered number); tracking required on every load; no-re-brokering clause and pickup driver and truck confirmation in the rate confirmation

threat_event: TMS account takeover: load details and pickup numbers used for a fictitious pickup, or carrier records altered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the TMS; reused passwords; audit log never reviewed
treatment_plan: Turn on authenticator-app MFA; monthly log review

threat_event: Broker identity hijack: the FMCSA registration account or the load board account is taken over and used to change contact details or post loads in the broker's name
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FMCSA account recovers to a personal email with a reused password and no MFA; load board password only; phone number on the FMCSA record out of date
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-11 FMCSA account; SYS-05 load board; BP-05
treatment_plan: Move FMCSA account recovery to the business email; unique passphrases; load board MFA; correct the FMCSA phone number; check the public FMCSA record monthly

threat_event: Shared railroad portal login is misused or discovered, and the railroad suspends portal access for that shipper
threat_source: Former shipper employee; railroad enforcement of portal terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Login belongs to a shipper employee who left in 2026-05; password unchanged; shared against the portal terms
treatment_plan: Ask the shipper to change the password now and request an individual third-party user ID from the railroad; stop using the shared login

threat_event: Carrier packets with Social Security numbers and driver license copies are exposed through open sharing links or forwarded email
threat_source: Owner error; anyone holding a link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 anyone-with-link shares (9 carrier packet folders) until 2026-08-12; tenant default still allows them; packets kept in email attachments
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 files and email; carrier personal information
treatment_plan: Set the tenant default to named recipients; keep W-9s only in the TMS carrier file; delete packet attachments from email; ask carriers for an EIN-based W-9 where they have one

threat_event: Owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the only phone, so loads in transit go unwatched, carriers go unpaid, and a surety claim goes unanswered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; email MFA on one phone; no backup broker agreement; 7-business-day surety and FMCSA response windows
treatment_plan: Written backup broker agreement; sealed emergency access sheet and hardware key with the transportation attorney; signed authorization for the attorney to answer surety and FMCSA notices (P05)

threat_event: TMS outage or data loss longer than the BIA allows (vendor RPO 24 hours against a 4-hour need for in-transit status)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; vendor RPO 24 hours
existing_controls: Vendor backups and availability commitments (SOC 2, P09)
treatment_plan: Download the in-transit list at 7 a.m. and 2 p.m. each business day; quarterly export of transaction records

threat_event: Transaction records are lost before the 3-year period ends, or carrier records are kept long after they are needed
threat_source: Owner error; vendor or subscription change
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention rule; records exist only in the TMS; nothing has ever been disposed of
existing_controls: Vendor retains all records while the subscription runs
treatment_plan: POL-01 8.7 retention schedule; quarterly export; first disposal of records past the schedule

threat_event: TMS document capture misses a damage or shortage note on a POD, and carrier pay is approved automatically before the shipper's claim arrives; vendor may train on customer documents
threat_source: Service provider (AI feature) and owner reliance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic approval of carrier pay on clean PODs since 2026-07-01; 3 of 9 exception notes missed in the trial; vendor terms allow model training unless the customer opts out
treatment_plan: Turn off automatic approval; owner reads every POD image before approving carrier pay; opt out of model training; monthly accuracy sample (P10)

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or a notice deadline is missed (shipper 72 hours; Florida 30 days)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or training
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact list; annual walkthrough; annual security course

threat_event: Attacker uses a dormant or unreviewed administrator account to take over the email suite
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IT consultant's super administrator account (password only, unused since 2022-02) was active until 2026-08-13; no account review
treatment_plan: Delete the account; quarterly review of every admin and user account in each SaaS service; IT consultant works only through sessions the owner starts

threat_event: Hurricane forces evacuation or cuts power and internet at the home office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single home office in northeast Florida
existing_controls: All systems are SaaS and reachable from anywhere over a phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop, hardware token, and in-transit list when a storm watch is issued
